items.title: 12.1 Nucleus ki banawat aur khusoosiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and topic 12.1 (PDF 262) in the book's order, with a table and a self-check.

blocks.text: Hum maante hain ke tamam atoms neutrons, protons aur electrons se bane hain. In teenon ke antiparticles (ulte zarre) bhi maloom hain. Positron (positive electron), neutrino aur photon bhi maloom hain. 1960s ke aakhir tak neutron aur proton jaise bohat se naye zarre daryaft hue. Inhein mesons kaha gaya; in ke masses zyada tar nucleons se kam magar electron se zyada the. Baad mein aise mesons bhi mile jin ke masses nucleons se zyada hain. Physicists ne aur bunyadi zarre dhoondhne shuru kiye jo in se bhi chhote hisson se bane hon; tajurbon ne is ki tasdeeq ki, aur in chhote hisson ko quarks kaha gaya. Is chapter mein hum maadde (matter) ki bunyadi eenton (building blocks) ko parhenge.

Atom ka nucleus do qism ke zarron se bana hai: protons aur neutrons. Proton sab se saade atom, hydrogen (jise protium kehte hain), ka nucleus hai. Proton par positive charge hai jis ki miqdar electron ke charge jitni hai (1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C), aur us ka mass 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg hai. Neutron, jis ka pata 1932 mein James Chadwick ne lagaya, naam ke mutabiq electrically neutral (be-charge) hai aur us ka mass taqreeban proton jitna hai. Nucleus ke in dono zarron (neutrons aur protons) ko nucleons kehte hain.

Hydrogen ke nucleus mein sirf ek proton hota hai, magar baqi sab elements ke nuclei mein neutrons aur protons dono hote hain. Mukhtalif nuclei ko nuclides kehte hain. Nucleus mein protons ki tadaad atomic number hai, alamat Z. Nucleons ki kul tadaad (neutrons + protons) ko A se likhte hain aur ise atomic mass number, ya sirf mass number, kehte hain. Neutrons ki tadaad:
Yahan N neutron number (neutrons ki tadaad) hai.

Kisi nucleus ko likhne ke liye ᴬ_Z X istemal hota hai: X element ki chemical alamat, oopar A (mass number) aur neeche Z (atomic number). Atomi zarron ka mass kilogram ki bajaye unified mass scale (u) mein likhte hain. Tareef ke mutabiq 1 u carbon-12 atom ke mass ka theek barahwan (1/12) hissa hai: 1 u = 1.6606 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, jis ki energy 931 MeV ke barabar hai. Is unit mein proton ka mass 1.007276 u, neutron ka 1.008665 u aur electron ka 0.00055 u hai.

Kisi ek element (maslan carbon) ke nuclei mein protons ki tadaad hamesha ek jaisi hoti hai magar neutrons mukhtalif ho sakte hain. Carbon ke nuclei mein hamesha 6 protons hote hain, magar 6, 7 ya 8 neutrons ho sakte hain. Jin nuclei mein protons barabar magar neutrons mukhtalif hon, unhein isotopes kehte hain. Carbon ke isotopes ¹²₆C, ¹³₆C aur ¹⁴₆C hain; ¹²₆C aur ¹³₆C stable (paidar) hain, magar ¹⁴₆C unstable hai aur β particle (electron) aur ek neutrino-qism ka zarra (asal mein antineutrino) kharij kar ke nitrogen ban jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Kisi element ke mukhtalif isotopes mein kya mushtarak hai aur kya mukhtalif (short question 12.1)? Woh element pehchaniye jis mein 87 nucleons aur 50 neutrons hain (short question 12.2).
blocks.explanation: Isotopes mein protons ki tadaad ek hai, to atomic number, electrons ki tarteeb aur kimiya ek hai; neutrons ki tadaad mukhtalif hai, to mass number, mass aur nuclear paidari mukhtalif (carbon-12 aur carbon-13 paidar, carbon-14 radioactive). Z = A - N = 87 - 50 = 37: element rubidium hai, rubidium-87.

items: Nucleus: protons (+e, 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg) aur neutrons (neutral, Chadwick 1932), dono mil kar nucleons. Z = atomic number, A = mass number, N = A − Z (12.1); alamat ᴬ_Z X.
1 u = carbon-12 atom ka 1/12 = 1.6606 × 10⁻²⁷ kg (931 MeV); proton 1.007276 u, neutron 1.008665 u, electron 0.00055 u. Isotopes: ek Z, mukhtalif N (¹²C, ¹³C, ¹⁴C; ¹⁴C beta decay se nitrogen).
